findings.reason: parameterizing on tolerance alone would either silently change mast_efit's acceptance (admitting an axis a spacing test wrongly rejects, or the reverse) or force a branch the single validator cannot express; the plan must name the predicate divergence, not just the tolerance, or scope those two sites out.
findings.text: the plan treats the three `_uniform_axis` copies as differing only by "tolerance policy", but they differ in *predicate*: map_extraction and diiid_efit (nova/media/sources/diiid_efit.py:38) test spacing-to-reconstruction within a tolerance, whereas mast_efit (nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py:44) deliberately tests against the reconstructed axis at stored (float32) precision because "a spacing test rejects an axis that is uniform to" it, and `LatticePolicy.__post_init__` (nova/equilibrium/conservation.py:146) enforces a node-count floor and positive radius, not a uniformity tolerance

findings.reason: the node's done-when ("the census grep over `nova/` returns zero literal paths outside the resolver") depends on a capability another plan owns landing first; with the dependency unstated, a worker may add a second resolver to `FilePath` — exactly the fork the plan says it avoids — or block, so the plan must name the cross-plan dependency and its ordering.
findings.text: the plan states `FilePath` "also resolves the GPFS evidence root of the receipts-out-of-git policy" (present tense), but `FilePath` carries no GPFS/evidence-root resolver today: `_resolve_absolute` (:209) handles only appdirs roots, and no `gpfs` / `evidence_root` / `imas_gpu` symbol exists in the module; that resolver is owned by the sibling plan converged-forward-solve (comment at docs/plans/converged-forward-solve.html:370)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — each node folds many copies behind one small owner (one residual implementation for the seven identical bodies at constraint.py:968,1049,1342,1390,1466,1528,1643; one axis validator; one atomic receipt writer; one IMAS opener; one path resolver). This is consolidation into deep owners, not a spread of shallow wrappers.

rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the plan adds to none of the four families and retires surface (three axis-validator copies, three atomic-writer copies, one orphan module), naming each retirement in its own text.
